expected_facts.text: PostgreSQL was selected as the database for relational reporting across tasks and owners.
Redis caching layer was deferred to post-MVP release v2.
Sync endpoint was paused waiting on the rate-limit decision.
Deploy script requires a manual environment variable fix.
JWT tokens with Argon2id are configured for authentication.

known_gaps.text: No architectural decision record explains why rate-limiting was deferred.
Sync endpoint has no designated successor or owner.
Conditions required to resume the sync endpoint remain undefined.

known_conflicts.text: tasks.csv assigns Auth module to A. Sample whereas chat_export.txt assigns it to B. Sample.

successor_questions.question: Which database was chosen and why?
successor_questions.expected_answer: PostgreSQL was chosen for relational reporting queries across tasks and owners.

successor_questions.question: Why is the sync endpoint paused?
successor_questions.expected_answer: It was paused waiting on a rate-limit decision.

successor_questions.question: Who owns the Auth module?
successor_questions.expected_answer: There is a conflict between tasks.csv (A. Sample) and chat logs (B. Sample) that requires clarification.

successor_questions.question: What is the status of the Redis cache layer?
Are there any manual steps required during deployment?
successor_questions.expected_answer: Yes, the deploy script requires a manual environment variable fix.
